# @descix/frqtl-web

> A discrete cellular-automata physics engine (compiled Rust → WASM) for the browser: interference,
> blackbody spectra and binding emerge from per-pixel rules (1 px/tick, single occupancy, momentum).
> 0.7.0-p1 on npm dist-tag `next`. Node twin: @descix/frqtl-node.

- Install: `npm install @descix/frqtl-web`
- See it run: https://egpt-frqtl.descix.net (the showcase scenes in STUDIO and the GYM)
- One-file form (global FRQTL): https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@descix/frqtl-web@0.7.0-p1/dist/frqtl-web.min.js
- A scene is an ES module: `export default function buildExperiment(exp)`, first statement
  `exp.createCanvas(w, h, cfg)` (2D, p5) or `exp.createScene(w, h, d, cfg)` (3D, three); parts from
  `@descix/frqtl-web/parts`. A part to read: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@descix/frqtl-web@0.7.0-p1/dist/frqtl/parts/DetectorWall.js
- Doors (`@descix/frqtl-web/boot`): `bootScene(mount, buildExperiment, opts)`;
  `bootProject(mount, { files: { 'sketch.js': text }, entry: 'sketch.js' }, opts)` or `{ url, entry }`; a folder whose
  `frqtl.json` names its entry boots as `{ files }` or `{ url }` with no `entry`.
- `./project`: `FRQTL_WEB_SPECIFIERS`, `libPathOf`, `importMapFor`, `pageImportMapFor`, `FRQTL_WEB_HOST_SPECIFIERS`, `linkProject`, `sketchProject`, `SKETCH_ENTRY`, `projectIdentity`, `MANIFEST_FILE`, `MANIFEST_KEYS`, `normalizeManifest`, `parseManifest`, `serializeManifest`, `manifestFor` (the owner of `frqtl.json`), `RECORD_FILES`, `RECORD_KEYS`, `CHANGE_KEYS`, `OPS`, `BY`, `CLIP_SECONDS`, `CLIP_NAME`, `clipName`, `jsonText`, `rowFaults`, `recordFolderFaults`, `applyRows` (the owner of a Record folder's shape; `rowFaults(row)` is `[]` for a valid change row; `recordFolderFaults(files)` is `[]` for a complete Record; `applyRows(partsBlock, rows)` returns a new block with the change rows applied in order, so `applyRows(parts.before, changes)` is `parts.after`; the entry stands alone: it registers the published parts itself).
- `./registry`: the roster contract (a host's scenes are its own: a roster JSON names them; the package ships no scene rows): `ROSTER_KEYS`, `normalizeRoster(json, href)` → the frozen bag every reader takes first; `loadRoster(href)` (absolute href; a page reads `rosterHrefOf(document)` off `<link rel="frqtl-roster" href>`); scene rows (`walkthroughById`, `walkthroughModes`, `effectiveRenderState`, `walkthroughIs3D`, `firstContactOf`, `sceneGroups`, `sceneUrlOf`); showcase cards (`exhibitFor`, `showcaseCard`, `showcaseIntro`, `showcaseHref(roster, card)`, `showcaseUrl(roster, card)` on the roster's `showcase.siteOrigin`); `projectOf(roster, id, { mode })` → `{ manifest, files, renderState }` (boot it with `bootProject(mount, { files }, { renderState })`), `emptyProjectOf({ router })`; and how STUDIO resolved the link it opened with (`STUDIO_LANDING_ATTR` on `<html>`, a `STUDIO_LANDING_OUTCOMES` id).
- `./studio`: `dist/studio/app.html`, STUDIO and the GYM as a page; it reads its scenes from its `<link rel="frqtl-roster" href>`.
- `./site-assemble` (node only): `assembleSite({ out, build, rosterHref, webDist, mathDist })` writes and proves a static site from the dists.
- `./kinds`: `registerKind`, `kindNamed`, `kindOf`, `registeredKinds` (a composed fork registers its renamed class).
- `./host-view`: `declareHostView`, `HOST_VIEW_OUTCOMES`, `CONTRACT_VIOLATIONS`, `HOST_SDK_SCRIPT` (an app asks its DeSciX shell for a view, once: `declareHostView({ sdk: window.DeSciX, mode, fallback })`; the outcome is on the html element's dataset).
- `./site-graph`: `SITE_GRAPH_DIR`, `SITE_BUILD_ATTR`, `SITE_BUILD_ID_RE`, `siteBuildStampOf`, `STATIC_APP_PAGE`, `SITE_STUDIO_DIR`, `HOST_PROVIDED_ATTR`, `SITE_PLACEMENTS`, `SITE_ENTRY_PAGES`, `isSiteEntry`, `siteGraphFaults` (the static site's shape: graph directory, build-stamp attribute, build id pattern and its reader, IDE entry page, the attribute declaring a file host-provided, the graph directory of each placed package, the entry pages; and the rule that a served graph is the placed releases' bytes; for a reader of a served site, both packages)
- `await recipeContext.fork(name, NewKind, { by })`: copies the `parts` entry's part file into the folder as `parts/<NewKind>.js` (class renamed, imports rewritten to package specifiers) and re-runs the scene in place.
- API reference: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@descix/frqtl-web@0.7.0-p1/dist/sdk.html
- Full agent guide: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@descix/frqtl-web@0.7.0-p1/CLAUDE.md
- Acceptance is visual; no CLI ships. No account, credits or tokens are needed.
